top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: Big mass in the left atrium, prolapse into the left ventricle, and obstructive symptoms are consistent with myxoma. Echocardiography also supports this diagnosis.
Left atrial mass, prolapse into the left ventricle, and obstructive symptoms are also seen in papillary fibroelastoma. However, the size of the mass is larger than typical for this condition.
Mass in the left atrium and obstructive symptoms are consistent with cardiac myxoma. However, there is no explicit mention of systemic embolization.
Big mass in the left atrium and obstructive symptoms could be seen in primary cardiac osteosarcoma, but this is a rare condition and the presentation is not typical.
Left atrial mass and valvular obstruction are seen in left atrial papillary fibroelastoma, but the size of the mass is larger than typical for this condition.
